scope_change_reason: The selected card asks for a new connector operation. This experiment retains the original one-root F2 connector and changes the source multiplicity from two toggles per source to one source toggled four times and six toggled twice. It tests the next possible even source-call count after the exact 140-call floor exclusion and targets the complete 63-mask sparse family. The first bounded construction is a two-boundary insertion of one restored toggle pair into the pinned 14-toggle maximum witness; if that surgery fails, one exact pivot covers the full normalized 16-event class.
actual_scope: Determine whether inserting one extra pair of the same source toggle at any two boundaries of the pinned seven-source 14-toggle maximum witness yields prefix differences covering every mask of weight 1, 2, or 3; if no insertion works, exhaust all normalized 16-event words with multiplicities (4,2,2,2,2,2,2). Combined with the independently replayed 14-toggle predecessor census, derive that no full 63-mask schedule can use 140 or 142 complete map calls in the original one-root, single-target event alphabet; the lower bound is 144, with no 144-call construction claimed.

question: Can one additional restored source-toggle pair extend a seven-source, one-root F2 connector path from the excluded 140-call floor to a 142-complete-call schedule realizing all 63 output masks of weights 1, 2, and 3?
method: Enumerate the 840 schedules obtained by selecting one source j in {0,...,6} and two insertion slots p<=q among the 15 boundaries of the pinned 14-toggle maximum word. Test the exact prefix-difference set against all 63 masks. If no insertion succeeds, use one bounded pivot: exhaust all 18,918,900 canonical multiset words with one label four times and six labels twice, stopping at the first full-cover word or after complete coverage. Independently replay a witness and every output boundary pair.

search_domain.first_stage: 7 * C(16,2) = 840 pair insertions into the 14-toggle witness, with two insertions at one slot allowed.
search_domain.fallback: 16!/(4! (2!)^6 6!) = 18,918,900 normalized words of multiplicities (4,2,2,2,2,2,2), source-label permutations quotiented.
search_domain.stop_rule: Stop at the first exact full-cover construction; if the 840 local surgeries miss, exhaust the fallback class. Never generalize a miss outside the tested domain.

optimistic_full_cost.descriptor_encoding: One opcode bit plus a 3-bit source-map ID for B calls or a 6-bit output-map ID for A calls; event order gives boundary placement.
optimistic_full_cost.complete_call_scope: Each c(B) and c(A) includes source/target access, arithmetic, target updates, private scratch restoration, hosting, and head return. Input admission I and coefficient preparation P are common and cancel. The static event order includes map IDs and boundary placement; no search table or frame change is charged separately.
optimistic_full_cost.other_constraints: This is a connector-level screen only. It does not place a supplier in the selected assembly; the selected record remains complex-bound, so no kappa improvement is claimed.
